notes.retained_docmass_share_of_streamed_docs: sum of retained doc_mass / docs_streamed. Below 1 both because the 20k cap drops tail domains and because some streamed docs have no parseable hostname.
notes.head_only_census: not an estimate: all 175 head domains were fetched (inclusion prob 1).

exclude.note: azj is mid tier, so high-vs-low is numerically unchanged; only high-vs-rest, the mid tier mean and the Spearman rank vector move.

site_type.notes: Keyword classes are non-exclusive substring matches on the hostname; 'tin' (Vietnamese 'tin tuc' = news) also matches 'bulletin', 'tintin', etc. TLD classes: org/edu/gov/mil/int or a public 2nd-level (ac./edu./gov./go./gob./gouv./or.) => org_edu_gov; 2-letter TLD not in the generic-use set (io,co,me,tv,cc,ai,ly,fm,to,gg,sh,st,am,is,ws) => ccTLD; else gTLD.

disagreements.note: Bytespider 'Disallow: *' (not literal '/'); malformed/non-standard token, but by intent (comment 'Evil Robots') and Google-style wildcard parsing this is block-all -- judgment call, flag for review
TRUNCATED at 6000 chars mid old-style scraper blocklist; no target AI agent visible before cutoff but cannot rule out a trailing AI-bot block (cf. linux-community.de pattern elsewhere in sample)

optout_with_404_in_denominator.note: analysis.py treats every non-200 as unreachable. A 404 is arguably an observed policy state (no robots.txt => no restrictions). This row puts 404/410 into the denominator as non-blocking.
